title: Phase II Study of Olaparib Combinations in HRD-Positive Advanced Ovarian Cancer
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Confirmed pathogenic somatic or germline mutation in BRCA1 or BRCA2; homologous recombination deficiency positive (HRD+). High-grade serous ovarian adenocarcinoma stage III or IV. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Adequate bone marrow and organ function. Exclusion: Prior PARP inhibitor resistance, untreated central nervous system metastases, concurrent chemotherapy.

title: Phase Ib/II Trial of Osimertinib Combination Therapies in Patients with EGFRm-positive and MET-amplified NSCLC (ORCHARD)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring EGFR activating mutation (L858R or Exon 19 del) with acquired MET amplification following disease progression on first-line osimertinib. Age >= 18. Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1. Exclusion: Active interstitial lung disease, severe hepatic impairment, prior MET inhibitor therapy.

locations.facility: The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust

title: Phase Ib/II Study of Amivantamab and Lazertinib in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC Post-Osimertinib (CHRYSALIS-2)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed metastatic NSCLC with sensitizing EGFR mutation (exon 19 del or L858R) that progressed on or after osimertinib. Bispecific targeting of EGFR and MET bypass resistance. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Untreated brain metastases, severe interstitial lung disease.

title: Study of MRTX849 (Adagrasib) in Combination with Cetuximab in KRAS G12C-Mutated Colorectal Cancer (KRYSTAL-10)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12C mutation (not G12D). Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Progression after fluoropyrimidine-based therapy. Exclusion: Untreated brain metastases, prior KRAS G12C inhibitor, active cardiac arrhythmia.

locations.facility: UC San Diego Moores Cancer Center

title: Testing the Addition of Abemaciclib to Olaparib for Women With Recurrent Ovarian Cancer
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Recurrent platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian carcinoma. Documented BRCA1/2 alteration or HRD loss of heterozygosity. Female age >= 18. ECOG <= 2. Hemoglobin >= 10 g/dL, ANC >= 1500, platelets >= 100k. Exclusion: Prior CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, severe gastrointestinal absorption disorders, active thromboembolism.

locations.facility: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania

title: Carboplatin or Olaparib for BRCA-Deficient and HRR-Mutated Metastatic Cancers
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Documented deleterious mutation in BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, or RAD51 family. Castration-resistant or platinum-sensitive metastatic solid tumors. Age >= 18. Adequate renal function CrCL > 51 mL/min. Exclusion: Small cell histology, prior PARP inhibitor resistance, known parenchymal brain metastasis.
sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development

locations.facility: VA Puget Sound Health Care System

title: Testing Olaparib for One or Two Years With or Without Bevacizumab in Ovarian Cancer
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: FIGO Stage III or IV ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal adenocarcinoma. Documented pathogenic variant in BRCA1 or BRCA2, or HRD positive. Completed frontline platinum chemotherapy. ECOG <= 2. Age >= 18. Exclusion: Prior PARP inhibitor maintenance, active gastrointestinal perforation risk.

title: Phase 1/2 Study of MRTX849 (Adagrasib) in Patients with Advanced Solid Tumors with KRAS G12C Mutation (KRYSTAL-1)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Unresectable or metastatic solid tumor harboring KRAS G12C mutation confirmed by CLIA-certified NGS. Progression after prior systemic therapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Active brain metastases requiring steroids, prior KRAS G12C targeted small molecule.

title: Phase III Trial of Sotorasib Plus Panitumumab in KRAS G12C-Mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (CodeBreaK 300)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Pathologically confirmed metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma with confirmed KRAS G12C mutation. Refractory to fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Previous treatment with KRAS inhibitor or anti-EGFR antibody, symptomatic brain metastases.

title: Phase III Trial of Alectinib Versus Crizotinib in Treatment-Naive ALK-Positive Advanced NSCLC (ALEX)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed advanced or metastatic NSCLC with ALK rearrangement centrally confirmed by Ventana IHC. No prior systemic therapy for advanced NSCLC. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-2. Exclusion: Prior ALK inhibitor therapy, severe pulmonary fibrosis, active cardiac arrhythmia.

title: Phase III Trial of Lorlatinib Versus Crizotinib in First-Line Advanced ALK-Positive NSCLC (CROWN)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Pathologically proven Stage IIIB or IV NSCLC with documented ALK rearrangement. No prior systemic therapy. Asymptomatic treated or untreated CNS metastases allowed. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-2. Exclusion: History of severe psychiatric disorders, uncontrolled hypercholesterolemia, concurrent CYP3A inducers.

title: Phase II Study of Dabrafenib Plus Trametinib in BRAF V600E Mutated Rare Cancers (ROAR)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Advanced solid tumors harboring BRAF V600E mutation centrally verified. Recurrent or refractory to standard therapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Adequate hematologic, renal, and cardiac ejection fraction >= 50%. Exclusion: History of retinal vein occlusion, interstitial lung disease, prior BRAF or MEK inhibitors.

title: Phase III Trial of Encorafenib Plus Cetuximab With or Without Binimetinib in BRAF V600E Colorectal Cancer (BEACON CRC)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma with presence of BRAF V600E mutation. Disease progression after 1 or 2 prior regimens. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Prior treatment with RAF inhibitor, MEK inhibitor, or anti-EGFR antibody.

title: Phase III Study of Alpelisib Plus Fulvestrant in Patients with PIK3CA-Mutated HR+/HER2- Advanced Breast Cancer (SOLAR-1)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Postmenopausal women or men with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer with confirmed PIK3CA alteration. Progression on or after aromatase inhibitor. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Fasting plasma glucose <= 140 mg/dL, HbA1c <= 6.4%. Exclusion: Type 1 diabetes or uncontrolled Type 2 diabetes, prior PI3K inhibitor.

title: Phase II Trial of Pembrolizumab in Microsatellite Instability-High (MSI-H) or dMMR Advanced Solid Tumors (KEYNOTE-158)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Histologically confirmed advanced unresectable or metastatic solid tumor with MSI-H or mismatch repair deficiency (dMMR) or TMB >= 10 mut/Mb. Progression on prior standard systemic therapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressants, prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody.

title: Phase III Trial of Nivolumab Plus Ipilimumab in First-Line Advanced NSCLC with High TMB (CheckMate 227)
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Treatment-naive recurrent or Stage IV NSCLC. Tumor mutational burden high (TMB >= 10 mut/Mb) assessed by validated assay. ECOG 0-1. Age >= 18. Brain metastases allowed if treated and asymptomatic. Exclusion: Known EGFR mutation or ALK translocation sensitive to targeted TKI, active autoimmune disease.

title: Phase Ib/II Study of Avelumab in Combination with Talazoparib in BRCA-Mutated or DDR-Deficient Advanced Solid Tumors
enrollmentCriteria: Inclusion: Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with documented deleterious mutation in BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, CHEK2, or other DDR pathway genes. Disease progression on standard therapy. Age >= 18. ECOG 0-1. Exclusion: Prior combination of PARP inhibitor plus anti-PD-L1 antibody, active pneumonitis.
